author: GPT-6 (Codex)
status: Judgmental calibration uncertainty; not a statistical posterior or measured causal marginal return. Specified before propagation.

normalization.rationale: Approximately one natural-log unit of broad algorithmic efficiency progress per year divided by approximately 1e29 actual R&D FLOPs per year. Fresh end-2025 lab-capacity data and a stated 2026 extrapolation supply the denominator. The broad roughly two-order 90% range allows substantial scope, attribution, precision, human-equivalence and marginal-versus-average uncertainty.

tail_prior: Preserve all weights, headroom and exponent draws from forecast_revision/forecast_prior.json; baseline log10 H maximum12. Do not retune the tail to maintain a desired answer.
independence: Calibration uncertainty is taken independent of tail parameters as an explicit simplifying judgment, not an empirically identified relation.
